segments.ja480:1.1: Akittiṃ [akattiṃ (ka.)] disvā sammantaṃ, sakko bhūtapatī bravi;
segments.ja480:1.3: Kiṃ patthayaṃ mahābrahme, eko sammasi ghammani.
segments.ja480:2.1: Dukkho punabbhavo sakka, sarīrassa ca bhedanaṃ;
segments.ja480:3.3: Varaṃ kassapa te dammi, yaṃ kiñci manasicchasi.
segments.ja480:4.1: Varaṃ ce me ado sakka, sabbabhūtānamissara;
segments.ja480:4.3: Yena putte ca dāre ca, dhanadhaññaṃ piyāni ca;
segments.ja480:4.5: Laddhā narā na [laddhā naññāni (ka.)] tappanti, so lobho na mayī vase.
segments.ja480:5.3: Varaṃ kassapa te dammi, yaṃ kiñci manasicchasi.
segments.ja480:6.1: Varaṃ ce me ado sakka, sabbabhūtānamissara;
segments.ja480:6.5: Yena jātena jīyanti, so doso na mayī vase.
segments.ja480:7.3: Varaṃ kassapa te dammi, yaṃ kiñci manasicchasi.
segments.ja480:8.1: Varaṃ ce me ado sakka, sabbabhūtānamissara;
segments.ja480:8.3: Bālaṃ na passe na suṇe, na ca bālena saṃvase;
segments.ja480:8.5: Bālenallāpa [bālenā’ lāpa (?)] sallāpaṃ, na kare na ca rocaye.
segments.ja480:9.1: Kiṃ nu te akaraṃ bālo, vada kassapa kāraṇaṃ;
segments.ja480:10.3: Dunnayo seyyaso hoti, sammā vutto pakuppati;
segments.ja480:10.5: Vinayaṃ so na jānāti, sādhu tassa adassanaṃ.
segments.ja480:11.3: Varaṃ kassapa te dammi, yaṃ kiñci manasicchasi.
segments.ja480:12.1: Varaṃ ce me ado sakka, sabbabhūtānamissara;
segments.ja480:12.3: Dhīraṃ passe suṇe dhīraṃ, dhīrena saha saṃvase;
segments.ja480:13.1: Kiṃ nu te akaraṃ dhīro, vada kassapa kāraṇaṃ;
segments.ja480:14.1: Nayaṃ nayati medhāvī, adhurāyaṃ na yuñjati;
segments.ja480:14.3: Sunayo seyyaso hoti, sammā vutto na kuppati;
segments.ja480:14.5: Vinayaṃ so pajānāti, sādhu tena samāgamo.
segments.ja480:15.3: Varaṃ kassapa te dammi, yaṃ kiñci manasicchasi.
segments.ja480:16.1: Varaṃ ce me ado sakka, sabbabhūtānamissara;
segments.ja480:16.3: Tato ratyā vivasāne [vivasane (sī. syā. pī.)], sūriyuggamanaṃ [suriyassuggamanaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] pati;
segments.ja480:16.5: Dibbā bhakkhā pātubhaveyyuṃ, sīlavanto ca yācakā.
segments.ja480:17.1: Dadato me [dadato ca me (pī.)] na khīyetha, datvā nānutapeyyahaṃ;
segments.ja480:17.3: Dadaṃ cittaṃ pasādeyyaṃ, etaṃ sakka varaṃ vare.
segments.ja480:18.3: Varaṃ kassapa te dammi, yaṃ kiñci manasicchasi.
segments.ja480:19.1: Varaṃ ce me ado sakka, sabbabhūtānamissara;
segments.ja480:19.3: Na maṃ puna upeyyāsi, etaṃ sakka varaṃ vare.
segments.ja480:20.1: Bahūhi vatacariyāhi [vattacariyāhi (sī. syā. ka.)], narā ca atha nāriyo;
segments.ja480:20.3: Dassanaṃ abhikaṅkhanti, kiṃ nu me dassane bhayaṃ.
segments.ja480:21.3: Disvā tapo pamajjeyya [disvā tapo pamajjeyyaṃ (sī. syā. pī.), disvānahaṃ pamajjeyyaṃ (cariyāpiṭakaṭṭhakathā)], etaṃ te dassane bhayanti.
